entities.summary: Lord Ronald Charles Sutherland-Leveson-Gower, was a British sculptor, best known for his statue of Shakespeare in Stratford-upon-Avon. He also wrote biographies of Marie Antoinette and Joan of Arc, as well as serving as Liberal Member of Parliament for Sutherland. He was accused by the Prince of Wales of "unnatural practices" and was one of several society figures implicated in the Cleveland Street Scandal, where a male brothel was raided by police.
